overview: A self-managing, icon-only audio control button for Zoom Video SDK sessions. On tap it joins audio, mutes, or unmutes the local participant based on current state. It registers as a delegate observer and automatically keeps its icon synchronized with the authoritative SDK audio status.

typeDefinitions.name: AudioButtonType

cases.name: join
cases.meaning: Local user has not joined session audio (audioType == .none)

cases.name: unmute
cases.meaning: Joined audio and currently unmuted (live mic)

typeDefinitions.note: Case names describe the CURRENT state, not the tap action. In .unmute (live) a tap mutes; in .mute a tap unmutes.

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitIconBtn
typeDefinitions.notes: UIButton subclass providing icon/badge/layout configuration and click callback dispatch.

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolKitManager
typeDefinitions.role: holds ZoomVideoSDK instance and videoSDKDelegate fan-out

typeDefinitions.name: CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate
typeDefinitions.role: weak fan-out delegate; register via add(_:) / remove(_:)

prerequisites: Zoom Video SDK initialized and registered with the toolkit via ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize(videoSDK:bundleId:) BEFORE constructing the button.
Construct and use on the main thread (@MainActor).
lifecycle.ifNotInitialized: If ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDK is nil, the button constructs in the 'join' state and tap actions have no effect (callback guards on audio helper and self).

actions: determine initial state from local audioStatus
build descriptor (40x40, clear bg, secondaryLabel icon color, zero padding)

exitPoints.note: Delegates are held weakly; removal is automatic cleanup.

lifecycle.delegateModel: The button does NOT assign itself to ZoomVideoSDK.delegate. It registers with the toolkit fan-out delegate ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate (CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate), enabling multiple observers. Child delegates are stored weakly.

stateTransitions.action: unmuteAudio(myself) -> unmuteAudio(nil) -> startAudio() (each only if prior failed)

stateTransitions.condition: authoritative; only when local user is in changed list

apis.name: init
apis.description: Reads local audio status to choose initial state/icon, constructs the button, registers as a delegate observer, and syncs state.

apis.name: init(coder:)
apis.description: NOT SUPPORTED. Calls fatalError. Do not instantiate from Storyboard/XIB.

apis.name: setMuteAudioIcon
apis.description: Overrides the icon used for the 'mute' (muted) state. Applied immediately if currently in the mute state.
sideEffects: Updates muteIcon; calls switchTo(.mute) if currentType == .mute

apis.name: setUnmuteAudioIcon
apis.description: Overrides the icon used for the 'unmute' (live mic) state. Applied immediately if currently in the unmute state.
sideEffects: Updates unmuteIcon; calls switchTo(.unmute) if currentType == .unmute

apis.name: setJoinAudioIcon
apis.description: Overrides the icon used for the 'join' state. Applied immediately if currently in the join state.
sideEffects: Updates joinIcon; calls switchTo(.join) if currentType == .join

apis.name: switchTo
apis.description: Sets currentType and updates the displayed image to match. Internal; documented for completeness.
sideEffects: Sets currentType and the normal-state image

apis.name: syncCurrentState
apis.description: Recomputes state from the SDK's current audio status and calls switchTo(type:). Called from init, didMoveToWindow, onSessionJoin, onUserAudioStatusChanged.

apis.name: didMoveToWindow
apis.description: UIView override. Refreshes the icon to the current SDK audio state when the button is attached to the view hierarchy.

inheritedConfiguration.warning: Do not use setIcon/setImage to represent audio state; it is transient and overwritten on the next resync. Use the per-state set*AudioIcon methods.

callbacks.name: onSessionJoin
callbacks.description: Fired when the local user joins the session. Resyncs the icon to the SDK audio status.
callbacks.stateChange: resyncs to match SDK audio status

callbacks.name: onUserAudioStatusChanged
callbacks.signature: public func onUserAudioStatusChanged(_ helper: ZoomVideoSDKAudioHelper?, user users: [ZoomVideoSDKUser]?)
callbacks.description: Fired when any user's audio status changes. Filters to the local user by ID and resyncs only when the local user is in the changed list. Primary mechanism for authoritative icon state (e.g. host-initiated mute).
callbacks.stateChange: resyncs to match SDK audio status for local-user changes only
inactiveConditions: local user ID cannot be resolved
local user not in changed list

errorHandling.strategy: The tap callback inspects the ZoomVideoSDKError returned by each helper call. The icon is updated optimistically ONLY on .Errors_Success; otherwise no UI change is made and the authoritative onUserAudioStatusChanged callback reconciles state.

perAction.onFailure: no UI change; rely on delegate resync

perAction.callOrder: each subsequent call only if the prior returned non-success
perAction.onFailure: if all three fail, no UI change

errorHandling.unmuteFallbackRationale: Self-unmute permissions vary by SDK state and participant role. Try explicit self-targeted unmute, then nil (local) unmute, then full startAudio() as last resort.
errorHandling.retryStrategy: The icon updates on success and reconciles via the delegate. To respond to action outcomes, observe SDK events via ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).

required: Initialize the toolkit (ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize) before constructing the button.
Construct and use the button on the main thread.
forbidden: Instantiating via init?(coder:) / Interface Builder (traps with fatalError).
Assigning the button (or anything) directly to ZoomVideoSDK.delegate; use ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).
Using inherited setIcon/setImage to represent audio state; it is overwritten on next resync.

examples.title: Add the button to a toolbar (happy path)
Customize per-state icons
examples.code:
let audioButton = ZMUIToolkitAudioBtn()
audioButton.setJoinAudioIcon(image: UIImage(named: "custom_join")!)
audioButton.setMuteAudioIcon(image: UIImage(named: "custom_muted")!)
audioButton.setUnmuteAudioIcon(image: UIImage(named: "custom_live")!)
